title: Tracto Script
description: Designer-format script for the Tracto Desktop Runtime

id.description: Unique artifact ID used as the Orchestrator artifact key (e.g. 'notepad-hello-world-001')

name.description: Human-readable script name shown in the Designer

targetRuntime.description: Runtime type — currently only 'desktop' is supported

description.description: Optional human-readable description of what this step does

parameters.description: All parameter values must be strings (the runtime casts to int/bool as needed)

action_key.description: key action: required 'key' param. Use {LWIN}s for Win+S, {ENTER}, %{F4} for Alt+F4, ^s for Ctrl+S

action_type.description: type action: required 'value' param. Supports ${varName.field} expansion and \n for newline

action_click.description: click action: required 'coordinates' param as 'x,y' string

action_scroll.description: scroll action: required 'coordinates' param as 'x,y'. delta defaults to 120 (positive=up)

action_navigate.description: navigate action: required 'window' param (partial window title, case-insensitive)

action_focus.description: focus action: activates a window or control

action_app_launch.description: app.launch action: launches or attaches to a Windows app

action_http_get.description: http.get action: HTTP GET; use storeAs to chain outputs as ${storeAs.statusCode}, ${storeAs.body}, ${storeAs.json}

action_file_saveAs.description: file.saveAs action: saves via Save As dialog. filePath supports %ENV% expansion
